protected_returns.clearance_method: Project every fixed-six emitted face polygon. Grid and axis witness lines use their separately frozen widths/opacities.

primary_outlines_layer.reason: All non-plinth visible-face outlines remain on their face elements and the plinth top boundary has its dedicated exactly-once layer; no independent, duplicate, or inferred outline geometry is allowed.
